details: The broader cryptocurrency market is experiencing a decline, with Bitcoin struggling to reclaim the $63,000 mark and sparking fears of a drop to $60,000. Ethereum (ETH) and other major digital assets have also seen broad losses, with ETH trading below its moving averages. The Fear & Greed Index has dropped to 17/100, indicating a fresh wave of investor concern. Notably, liquidations have cooled slightly from yesterday, and Michael Saylor's Strategy has reportedly begun buying Bitcoin again amidst this volatility.
title: Crypto Markets Face Continued Downturn, Bitcoin Struggles Below $63K

details: Asset manager 21Shares released its mid-year crypto market report, auditing 2026 industry forecasts. The report points to a $100,000 year-end base case for Bitcoin, following its peak of approximately $126,000 in October 2025. It suggests that Bitcoin's current pullback aligns with historical post-halving patterns.
title: 21Shares Forecasts Bitcoin Recovery Towards $100,000 by Year-End

details: The market capitalization of tokenized real-world assets (RWAs) has surpassed $51 billion, marking a 40% increase since the beginning of 2026. This growth occurs despite a 20% decline in the broader cryptocurrency market, indicating rising institutional interest in the sector.
title: Tokenized Real-World Assets (RWAs) Market Cap Exceeds $51 Billion

details: THORChain, a decentralized cross-chain liquidity protocol, has resumed trading after more than five weeks of downtime. The pause in operations was triggered by a May exploit, but transaction signing, liquidity provider actions, and swaps are now available again.
title: THORChain Resumes Trading After May Exploit Downtime

details: BlackRock, the world's largest asset manager, states that Bitcoin's role in investment portfolios is evolving. Managing Director Michael Gates recommends allocating about 1% to 2% of a total portfolio to BTC, viewing it as a "supplemental diversifier" that can boost returns without excessive risk.
title: BlackRock Recommends 1-2% Bitcoin Allocation for Diversification

details: Cryptocurrency firm OKX and Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), parent company of the New York Stock Exchange, have formed a joint venture. Former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo will co-chair the initiative, which aims to build infrastructure for tokenized financial products and explore regulatory-compliant blockchain-enabled markets.
title: OKX and NYSE Owner Form Joint Venture for Tokenized Products

details: Ethereum is currently trapped below all its major moving averages, indicating a textbook bear market structure. June is shaping up to be the worst calendar month for ETH in 2026, already down 29% from May. Adding to the bearish sentiment, the anticipated "Glamsterdam" upgrade, expected to lower fees and boost L1 performance, has been postponed to H2 2026.
title: Ethereum Faces Bear Market Conditions; Glamsterdam Upgrade Postponed
